snippet.title: Candy Luna Park | Official Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
Harvest candy, build whimsical rides, and design your dream getaway in this cozy theme park builder. Relax as you expand your sugary world and watch your slice of paradise flourish. One attraction at a time!

Wishlist now on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3602180/Candy_Luna_Park/
